run_doctest_docstring: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python docstring generation for C++ bound functions
test_docstring_generation: test that C++ bound functions expose correct docstrings with signatures in Python
verify_docstring_options: verify docstring behavior when user docstrings and C++ signatures are toggled on or off
print_module_help: print the pydoc module help for the docstring_ext extension module
check_docstring_lines: check the number of lines in generated docstrings for various docstring configuration combinations
